recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If the work group resolves FHIR-50549 or FHIR-54549, reconcile the live search.cfm/searchform behavior under those issue keys rather than reopening this DSTU2 ballot comment.
issue_request: FHIR-11438 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request from the 2016 September core ballot asking that search actually be enabled for the FHIR specification search page at the 2016sep search.cfm URL. It was voted 8-0-0, applied for DSTU2, and later received Grahame Grieve's comment that it had been done.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-11438 was found. tools/html/search.cfm was introduced in 2016 as a static placeholder before the issue was filed, while a 2017 Zulip thread records Grahame announcing that specification search was working again at hl7.org/fhir/search.cfm. Later source history added source/search-build.html with a DuckDuckGo search iframe and registered it in publish.ini and hierarchy.xml.
additional_context: Earlier Published/Persuasive search-capability issues FHIR-8151, FHIR-7712, and FHIR-6849, plus duplicate FHIR-7748, are the same change family. The combined branch already has the FHIR-8151 source reconciliation, which changed the current home page and footer to use search-location instead of hard-coded search.cfm. FHIR-50549 and FHIR-54549 later report broken live search.cfm links, but they remain unresolved and were treated as background rather than applied scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source has an active search-build page in build scope and user-facing search links now use the configured search-location target, so this seed does not require another source edit. Editing search.cfm here would duplicate FHIR-8151 or preempt unresolved later live-site decisions.
